name: Party Thrasher
clause: Noncreature spells you cast from exile have convoke.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'impulse-choose'; count: number; take: number; until: 'eot' | 'next-turn' } - exile the top `count` cards, choose `take` of them, and only those may be played.
needs.semantics: Party Thrasher's 'exile the top two cards of your library, then choose one of them. You may play that card this turn.' Today impulse makes every exiled card playable, which is strictly better than the card prints.
needs.clause: If you do, exile the top two cards of your library, then choose one of them. You may play that card this turn.
